entries.reason: the contract is not readable on this machine, and a row must not invent one. Neither name is declared by either SDK this package can read: 0 files of the whole 16.4 build SDK name NSPredicateValidating and 0 name allowEvaluationWithValidator, and 0 files of the 26.2 SDK name either - with NSPredicate itself in 95 files of the 16.4 and 75 of the 26.2, the control that says the search does find headers. The row's own introduced is 26.4 (coordination/corpus/registry-last.tsv), and 26.2 is the newest header here, so the SDK that declares the pair is not on this machine; the held release ladder stops at 18.0, which is older than the pair too, so the release's own metadata cannot say what either name declares either. NSPredicateValidating's required selector is the whole contract of the protocol and the method's return type is part of the method's, so writing either from the name would be a guess about a signature
